page0.text:
I run in a hurry.
I hear another set of footsteps.
Saber is following behind me.

page1.text:
"You're late. You have some nerve making a girl wait."
I don't have any nerve.
It seems it's already been decided that we're going on a date without my consultation.

page2.text:
"Wait, hold on...! Why are we going out!?"
Because I feel like it. You don't mind right? It's not like we're doing anything during the day. I won't let you run away now.

page3.text: "Er... Well, I don't mind, but... Yeah, what about Archer!? He must be against something like this!"

page4.text: "I left Archer. I bet he's sleeping at my house right now."

page5.text:
...
...I can't win.
I can't talk down Tohsaka on my own.
If anyone can stop her, um...

page6.text:
"That's right, Saber! What about Saber?"
"Saber is fine, she can accompany us."
Defeated.
All my cards are trumped with just one sentence.

page7.text:
"Have you accepted it now? Then let's hurry. We're going to forget our duties as Masters and have fun."
"Huh... Hey, wait I said, idiot...!"
There's no time to be confused.
Tohsaka grabs my hand and runs out the door.
